vi. 平静下来；镇定下来","audio":"calm.mp3"},{"word":"cool","pronun":"[kuːl]","translation":"n. 凉爽；凉爽的空气

vi. 变凉；平息
adv. 冷静地","audio":"cool.mp3"},{"word":"depressed","pronun":"[dɪˈprest]","translation":"adj. 沮丧的；萧条的；压低的
